messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: How does one install a package on glimmer?
parts:
Hi Karthik -

You can log on to the RStudio Server on glimmer, at http://glimmer.rstudio.com:8787/ and install it from within RStudio.

-Winston
